services.name: AmStar Emergency Medical Services
services.area: whole county (based in Demopolis; stations in Linden and Dixons Mills)
services.evidence: Based in Demopolis , with additional stations in Linden and Dixons Mills , we are committed to providing dependable, high-quality emergency and non-emergency medical transportation across Marengo County and surrounding communities. ... We provide a full range of EMS Services including 911 Emergency Response, Hospital-to-Hospital Transfers, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation and Dialysis Transport Services.
services.vintage: 2026 (site has a May 2026 post; page undated)

01091.page_note: AmStar EMS, based in Demopolis with stations in Linden and Dixons Mills, provides 911 ambulance service across Marengo County.
01091.second_source: https://amstarems.com/ ("AmStar EMS is an Ambulance Provider in Marengo county in West Alabama"); ADPH licence list: AmStar is the only transport licence based in Marengo

services.name: Lawrence County EMS (Greg's Ambulance Service)
services.area: whole county; a backup ambulance is housed at Speake Fire and Rescue
services.evidence: He was transferred to Lawrence County EMS and taken to a local hospital for further evaluation.

01079.page_note: Lawrence County EMS (Greg's Ambulance Service) answers 911 calls and transports patients in Lawrence County. A backup Lawrence County EMS ambulance is kept at the Speake fire station.
01079.second_source: https://www.moultonadvertiser.com/news/article_6b3ad657-a821-4981-8cc3-a0d2c4c1b980.html (2026-01: Speake Fire 'new partnership with Lawrence County EMS, allowing a backup ambulance to be housed at its station'); https://www.moultonadvertiser.com/news/article_7934a042-d0f1-40ca-8066-6e46954e2caf.html (2025-09: ambulance donated to Speake by Greg's Ambulance Service)

services.name: Haynes Ambulance (Bullock station)
services.evidence: Bullock Station – 212 N. Baskin Street, Union Springs, Alabama 36089

01011.page_note: Haynes Ambulance runs an ambulance station in Union Springs and is the only ground ambulance service licensed in Bullock County. A page naming it as the county's 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.
01011.second_source: https://governor.alabama.gov/newsroom/2026/08/governor-ivey-announces-first-grants-in-major-new-rural-healthcare-program-totaling-more-than-144-million/ (Haynes grant for 'rural emergency medical service stations' incl. Bullock)

services.name: Dallas County volunteer fire and rescue squads (15)
services.evidence: The LUCAS devices will keep people alive until the ambulance arrives and can stay with the patient in the ambulance until they get to the hospital.

01047.page_note: Dallas County's volunteer rescue squads respond first and wait for an ambulance. The only licensed ground ambulance service based in the county is Jackson Emergency Transport Service, but a page naming it as the 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.
